systems: Terraform state locking (DynamoDB / filesystem `.terraform.tfstate.lock.info`): writes structured JSON lock owner ID, refuses unlock unless `-force-unlock LOCK_ID` matches, and bounds acquisition via `-lock-timeout=DURATION`
Linux `flock` / Git `.lock` (`lockfile.c`): stages payload in a PID-unique tempfile and publishes via atomic `link(2)`/`rename(2)` so readers never observe truncated lock metadata
PostgreSQL / Consul session locks: scopes locks per target resource namespace and acquires sorted multi-target sets to eliminate AB-BA deadlocks
